title: Micrograms Of Salmeterol
comment: This zine was released as part of a bundle for Cangkang Serigala's single with the same title. Published by Langma Records, the bundle also includes a poster and a CD (inside of the zine). During one of their comeback performance in 2015, one of the band member threw this zine into the crowd, and that's how it ended up in our hands. Cangkang Serigala is a legendary music project formed in 2006 by three visual artists: Ahmad Oka, Arsita Pinandita & Ican Harem, while they were studying visual art at the Indonesian Institute of the Arts, Yogyakarta.
